>## Notes for reviewers

>## Summary of changes
>
>### Major Features
>- Retrieve node name from metadata service ([#2279](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/gcp-compute-persistent-disk-csi-driver/pull/2279))
>  -  Already present in OCP 4.22 as a cherry-pick.
>- Smart attach limits for nodes ([#2268](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/gcp-compute-persistent-disk-csi-driver/pull/2268))
>  - Disabled in OCP, needs cmdline arguments + set up a webhook + taint controller sidecar. Prevents scheduler to put Pods to a node until CSINode with attach limit exists.
>- GCE disk provisioning/attach status labels ([#2274](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/gcp-compute-persistent-disk-csi-driver/pull/2274))
>  - Disabled in OCP, needs a cmdline argument. Probably harmless to enabled.
>- Fail-close on auth error for GKE ([#2294](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/gcp-compute-persistent-disk-csi-driver/pull/2294))
>  - Disabled in OCP, needs a cmdline argument. Could be useful when using token based auth, but investigation is needed.
>- PD Restriping Feature ([#2296](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/gcp-compute-persistent-disk-csi-driver/pull/2296))
>  - Updates a disk when being attached to a Gen 4 machine.
>  - Fast metadata-only change is enabled by default (in OCP).  The disk may be slow until GCE finishes the update in the background.
>  - We may opt-in for a complete (and slow) change via a cmdline argument. It will slow down attachment, but all subsequent access to the disk will be fast.
>- Cluster identification label added to disks ([#2306](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/gcp-compute-persistent-disk-csi-driver/pull/2306))
>  -  Disabled in OCP, adds a new label to a disk with a hash of the cluster name. We already have `<clustername>:owned` label.
>- Garbage collector for leaked disks ([#2309](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/gcp-compute-persistent-disk-csi-driver/pull/2309))
>  - Disabled in OCP. It would delete all volumes without owner label introduced above.
>- Init-container for storage class default annotation restoration ([#2325](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/gcp-compute-persistent-disk-csi-driver/pull/2325))
>  -  Disabled in OCP, solves some GCE upgrade problems that we solve by a StorageClass controller in our operator.
>
>### Notable Bug Fixes
>- Relaxed storage pool validation ([#2285](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/gcp-compute-persistent-disk-csi-driver/pull/2285))
>- Remove duplicate call to mutex.Unlock ([#2332](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/gcp-compute-persistent-disk-csi-driver/pull/2332))
>- Honor stderrthreshold when logtostderr is enabled ([#2291](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/gcp-compute-persistent-disk-csi-driver/pull/2291))
>- Replace multi-tenant kubeconfig helper with sigs package ([#2312](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/gcp-compute-persistent-disk-csi-driver/pull/2312))
>- Removed cross-project storage pool check ([#2305](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/gcp-compute-persistent-disk-csi-driver/pull/2305))

## Walkthrough The PR adds three major CSI driver features: a startup node taint controller and admission webhook, automated PD disk conversion on attach failure, and GCE disk publish-status labeling with disk-leak cleanup. It also introduces a new standalone `gce-pd-default-sc-rollback-handler` binary, adds alpha Compute API support with `fail-close-on-auth-error`, consolidates k8s client retry helpers, relaxes storage-pool cross-project/zone validation, bumps Go to 1.26.4, and purges historical changelog files. ## Changes **Startup Node Taint Controller and Webhook** | Layer / File(s) | Summary | |---|---| | **Startup taint constants and shared RBAC/k8s manifests**
`pkg/constants/constants.go`, `deploy/kubernetes/base/controller/rbac-taint-controller.yaml`, `deploy/kubernetes/base/controller/kustomization.yaml`, `deploy/kubernetes/base/webhook/service-account.yaml`, `deploy/kubernetes/base/webhook/rbac-webhook.yaml`, `deploy/kubernetes/base/webhook/service.yaml`, `deploy/kubernetes/base/webhook/webhook-config.yaml`, `deploy/kubernetes/base/webhook/kustomization.yaml` | Adds `StartupTaintKey/Value/Effect`, `ClusterIDLabel`, and status constants; introduces RBAC ClusterRole/Binding for taint controller and webhook; adds ServiceAccount, Service, MutatingWebhookConfiguration, and Kustomize wiring for all webhook resources. | | **Taint remover controller implementation and tests**
`pkg/controller/taint/taint_remover.go`, `pkg/controller/taint/taint_remover_test.go` | Implements `ReconcileNodeTaint` watching CSINode and Node objects; removes startup taint once driver is registered or node exceeds grace period; performs merge-patch retaining all other taints; full table-driven unit tests covering all reconcile paths. | | **NodeTainter admission webhook implementation and tests**
`pkg/webhook/taint/node_taint.go`, `pkg/webhook/taint/node_taint_test.go` | Implements `NodeTainter` handler that appends the startup taint on node CREATE unless the disable label or existing taint is detected; tests cover patch, idempotent, decode-error, and skip scenarios. | | **Webhook deployment and cert-setup manifests**
`deploy/kubernetes/base/webhook/deployment.yaml`, `deploy/kubernetes/base/webhook/cert-setup.yaml` | Adds 2-replica Deployment for `pd-csi-taint-webhook` (port 9443, TLS secret mount); adds cert-setup Job with embedded shell script generating self-signed cert and patching webhook `caBundle`. | | **Controller deployment: taint toleration and taint-controller sidecar**
`deploy/kubernetes/base/controller/controller.yaml` | Adds pod toleration for startup taint, `--enable-multitenancy=false` flag to main driver container, and a new `taint-controller` sidecar container with dedicated metrics port and shared cloud credentials. | | **Main entrypoint flags and runTaintManager wiring**
`cmd/gce-pd-csi-driver/main.go` | Adds taint controller/webhook CLI flags; validates `clusterOwnershipID`; adds early-exit branch to `handle()` that invokes `runTaintManager`; implements `runTaintManager` building a controller-runtime manager with optional webhook and taint controller registration; updates driver name references to `constants.DriverName`. | **PD Conversion, GCE Disk Status Labeling, and Disk Cleanup** | Layer / File(s) | Summary | |---|---| | **Shared constants, label helpers, and contracts**
`pkg/metrics/metrics.go`, `pkg/metrics/metadata.go`, `pkg/convert/convert.go`, `pkg/common/utils.go`, `pkg/common/utils_test.go`, `pkg/parameters/types.go`, `pkg/parameters/parameters.go`, `pkg/parameters/parameters_test.go` | Adds `DefaultConversionResult` constant and `SetConversionResult` helper; exports `CheckLabelValue` refactored from `ConvertLabelsStringToMap`; adds `IsSuperset` utility; extends `ParameterProcessor` with `EnableGCEDiskStatus`/`ClusterOwnershipID`; conditionally injects status and cluster ID labels in `ExtractAndDefaultParameters`. | | **Cloud provider: alpha API, fail-close auth, SetDiskLabels, ConvertDisk**
`pkg/gce-cloud-provider/compute/gce-compute.go`, `pkg/gce-cloud-provider/compute/gce.go`, `pkg/gce-cloud-provider/compute/cloud-disk.go`, `pkg/gce-cloud-provider/compute/fake-gce.go`, `pkg/gce-cloud-provider/compute/gce_test.go`, `pkg/gce-cloud-provider/compute/tenancy/informer.go` | Adds alpha Compute API client, `failCloseOnAuthError` parameter, `GetLabelFingerprint`, `SetDiskLabels`, `ConvertDisk` (using alpha `Disks.Convert` with quick/slow path), `WaitForLongRunningOpBackoff`, refactors zonal op wait helpers; switches tenancy setup to controller-runtime `config.GetConfig()`; fixes mutex double-unlock; extends fake provider with conversion test controls. | | **k8sclient package consolidation**
`pkg/k8sclient/client.go` | Introduces unified `client.go` with overridable `GetClient`, shared backoff, and exported retry wrappers for Node, StorageClass, PersistentVolume, and Pod list; removes old `node.go`. | | **ControllerPublish: disk status labeling and PD conversion subsystem**
`pkg/gce-pd-csi-driver/controller.go`, `pkg/gce-pd-csi-driver/gce-pd-driver.go`, `pkg/gce-pd-csi-driver/controller_test.go` | Extends `GCEControllerServer/Args` with status and ownership fields; adds `updateVolumePublishStatusLabel`; wires best-effort label update on attach; adds `convertDiskAndReAttach`, `isConversionRequiredError`, `isSlowConversionRequiredError`, `optedInForSlowConversion`; wires conversion+re-attach on attach error; adds tests for disk status labels and PD conversion scenarios. | | **Disk-leak cleanup: VerifyClusterDisks and tests**
`pkg/gce-pd-csi-driver/cleanup.go`, `pkg/gce-pd-csi-driver/cleanup_test.go` | Adds `VerifyClusterDisks` (async per-disk goroutines), `listDisks` (GCE label filter), `handleDisk` (parse metadata, validate PV/PVC, conditionally label or delete disk), `getDiskMeta`, `validateAssociatedObjects`, `labelFilter`; full table-driven tests for each helper. | | **Main driver entrypoint: new flags and disk status startup wiring**
`cmd/gce-pd-csi-driver/main.go` | Adds `--enable-pd-conversion`, `--gce-disk-status`, `--enable-disk-cleanup`, `--cluster-ownership-id` flags; passes `failCloseOnAuthError` to `CreateCloudProvider`; wires new args into controller server; triggers `VerifyClusterDisks` on startup when disk status is enabled. | | **Storage pool validation relaxation**
`pkg/gce-pd-csi-driver/utils.go`, `pkg/gce-pd-csi-driver/utils_test.go` | Replaces cross-project pool error with a debug log; changes zone topology check from equality to subset (`IsSuperset`); updates test expectations accordingly. | | **gRPC OTel telemetry refactor**
`pkg/gce-pd-csi-driver/server.go` | Replaces `otelgrpc.UnaryServerInterceptor()` chain injection with a `grpc.StatsHandler(otelgrpc.NewServerHandler())` server option. | **Default StorageClass Rollback Handler** | Layer / File(s) | Summary | |---|---| | **scdefaultrestorer package: Config, Restorer, and tests**
`pkg/scdefaultrestorer/restorer.go`, `pkg/scdefaultrestorer/restorer_test.go` | Implements `Config`/`Restorer` types and `Run` method: polls `/healthz`, inspects marker annotation, and either restores the default annotation or removes the marker depending on whether other default StorageClasses exist; table-driven tests for all annotation scenarios. | | **Rollback handler entrypoint, Dockerfile, Makefile, and Cloud Build**
`cmd/default-sc-rollback-handler/main.go`, `Dockerfile.default-sc-rollback-handler`, `Makefile`, `cloudbuild.yaml` | Adds CLI entrypoint wiring `scdefaultrestorer.Config`; adds multi-stage Dockerfile targeting `gce-pd-default-sc-rollback-handler`; adds Makefile variables and build/push/multi-arch targets; adds Cloud Build step and tag. | **Build, Dependency, and Maintenance Updates** | Layer / File(s) | Summary | |---|---| | **Go 1.26.4 image bumps and go.mod dependency updates**
`Dockerfile`, `Dockerfile.Windows`, `Dockerfile.debug`, `Dockerfile.node-labeler`, `cloudbuild.yaml`, `go.mod` | Bumps all builder images to `golang:1.26.4`; pins `gcb-docker-gcloud` by SHA256 digest; updates `go.mod` direct and indirect dependencies including `k8s.io/*` to `v0.35.2` and removes `go.opencensus.io`. | | **Changelog cleanup, hack scripts, and minor fixes**
`CHANGELOG.md`, `CHANGELOG/*`, `hack/verify-*.sh`, `cmd/gce-pd-node-labeler/main.go`, `deploy/kubernetes/overlays/dev/kustomization.yaml`, `docs/kubernetes/user-guides/dynamic-volumes.md`, `test/run-windows-k8s-integration.sh` | Removes all historical CHANGELOG files; updates CHANGELOG.md link; adds success echoes to verify scripts; improves `verify-gofmt.sh` with staged find+captured exit code; fixes Windows integration test if-syntax; updates node-labeler klog settings; minor doc/overlay comment fix. | ## Sequence Diagram(s) ```mermaid sequenceDiagram participant Node as Kubernetes Node participant NodeTainter as NodeTainter Webhook participant TaintRemover as ReconcileNodeTaint participant CSINode participant CSIDriver as gce-pd-driver Note over Node,NodeTainter: Node creation Node->>NodeTainter: CREATE admission request NodeTainter->>NodeTainter: hasStartupTaint? / disable label? NodeTainter-->>Node: Patch: add startup taint (NoSchedule) Note over TaintRemover,CSIDriver: Driver starts on node CSIDriver-->>CSINode: Registers driver (creates CSINode) CSINode-->>TaintRemover: Watch event triggers reconcile TaintRemover->>Node: Get node, check startup taint present TaintRemover->>CSINode: Get CSINode, check driver registered TaintRemover->>Node: Patch: remove startup taint ``` ```mermaid sequenceDiagram participant Controller as ControllerPublish participant GCE as CloudProvider participant k8s as Kubernetes API Controller->>GCE: AttachDisk(disk, instance) alt conversion required error Controller->>GCE: ConvertDisk(quickOnly=true) alt quick conversion OK Controller->>GCE: AttachDisk (retry) Controller->>GCE: SetDiskLabels(AttachedStatus) else slow conversion required Controller->>k8s: GetPV / GetStorageClass / GetNode / ListPods alt annotation opts in for slow conversion Controller->>GCE: ConvertDisk(quickOnly=false) Controller->>GCE: AttachDisk (retry) Controller->>GCE: SetDiskLabels(AttachedStatus) else no opt-in Controller-->>Controller: FailedPrecondition error end end else attach success Controller->>GCE: SetDiskLabels(AttachedStatus) end ``` ## Estimated code review effort 🎯 5 (Critical) | ⏱️ ~120 minutes
✨ Finishing Touches
🧪 Generate unit tests (beta) - [ ] Create PR with unit tests

pkg/k8sclient/client.go-69-143 (1)
`69-143`: _🩺 Stability & Availability_ | _🟡 Minor_ | _⚡ Quick win_ **Real API error is swallowed by the backoff loop.** In all four `*WithRetry` helpers the condition func returns `(false, nil)` on every API error, so once `Steps` is exhausted `ExponentialBackoffWithContext` returns its own timeout sentinel (`ErrWaitTimeout`/context error) rather than the last API error. Callers (and the `klog.Errorf` lines) therefore log/propagate a generic "timed out waiting for the condition" instead of the underlying cause (e.g. RBAC forbidden, NotFound), which makes failures hard to diagnose. Capture the last error and surface it. Additionally, non-retryable errors such as `NotFound` are retried through the full backoff (~15s) before failing; consider short-circuiting on terminal errors.
🛡️ Example fix (apply pattern to all four helpers) ```diff func getNodeWithRetry(ctx context.Context, kubeClient kubernetes.Interface, nodeName string) (*v1.Node, error) { var nodeObj *v1.Node + var lastErr error err := wait.ExponentialBackoffWithContext(ctx, backoff, func(_ context.Context) (bool, error) { node, err := kubeClient.CoreV1().Nodes().Get(ctx, nodeName, metav1.GetOptions{}) if err != nil { + lastErr = err klog.Warningf("Error getting node %s: %v, retrying...\n", nodeName, err) return false, nil } nodeObj = node klog.V(4).Infof("Successfully retrieved node info %s\n", nodeName) return true, nil }) if err != nil { + if lastErr != nil { + err = lastErr + } klog.Errorf("Failed to get node %s after retries: %v\n", nodeName, err) } return nodeObj, err } ```
🤖 Prompt for AI Agents ``` Verify each finding against current code. Fix only still-valid issues, skip the rest with a brief reason, keep changes minimal, and validate. In `@pkg/k8sclient/client.go` around lines 69 - 143, The four retry helpers getNodeWithRetry, getStorageClassWithRetry, getPersistentVolumeWithRetry, and listPodsInNamespace are swallowing the real API error by returning false,nil from the backoff callback, so the caller only sees a generic timeout from ExponentialBackoffWithContext. Capture the last error inside each helper and return it after the backoff loop, and have the callback preserve terminal errors instead of retrying them blindly. Use the existing klog.Warningf/klog.Errorf paths to log the underlying error so callers get the actual RBAC/NotFound cause rather than only ErrWaitTimeout. ```
pkg/constants/constants.go-84-86 (1)
`84-86`: _🎯 Functional Correctness_ | _🟡 Minor_ **Rename `AttachedStatus` to match the `attaching` state.** `pkg/constants/constants.go:84-86` uses `AttachedStatus = "attaching"`, and the controller writes that value during publish. Rename it to `AttachingStatus` (or change the value to `"attached"`) so the lifecycle state is unambiguous.
🤖 Prompt for AI Agents ``` Verify each finding against current code. Fix only still-valid issues, skip the rest with a brief reason, keep changes minimal, and validate. In `@pkg/constants/constants.go` around lines 84 - 86, The lifecycle constant name and value are inconsistent in constants.go: `AttachedStatus` is set to `"attaching"`, but the controller uses that state during publish.
